newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling eases vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling eases vs dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling eased marginally on Friday in quiet trading, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 55.08 against the dollar compared to 55.05 on Thursday while against the pound it was posted at a mean rate of 90.78 from 90.21.
"The shilling is holding steady," a dealer said.

Forex dealers said that because the state budget, released on Thursday did not touch on interest rates, Kenya was still an attractive market for investing in treasury bills against a background of a steady shilling.
"We have not seen any impact on the shilling," another dealer said.
They said they expected a thin market ahead of the weekend.
The money market eased marginally with overnight rates quoted at between 8-11 percent from 12 percent on Thursday.
